name: College Technical Fest 2026
goal: Organize our college technical fest in 10 days, including venue booking, sponsorships, event scheduling, and volunteer assignments.

tasks.title: Secure Campus Venues and Resource Permits
tasks.description: Reserve the main auditorium, lab rooms, and outdoor grounds. Acquire university security, AV equipment, and electrical clearance for all fest days.

tasks.title: Finalize Core Sponsors and Budget Allocation
tasks.description: Close outreach to target tech sponsors, sign partnership agreements, collect committed funds, and disburse operational allocations across departments.

tasks.title: Deploy Fest Registration Portal & Scheduling Engine
tasks.description: Launch the event website with attendee registration, workshop ticketing, live schedule integration, and backend submission review pipelines.

tasks.title: Confirm Industry Mentors and Launch PR Campaign
tasks.description: Onboard workshop leads and hackathon judges, finalize travel/honorarium logistics, and release social media blitz and campus-wide promotional material.

tasks.title: Recruit and Assign Volunteer Crews
tasks.description: Select student volunteers, assign them to track leads (hospitality, security, stage management, registration desks), and conduct a briefing session.

tasks.title: Conduct Technical Dry Run and Venue Setup
tasks.description: Test stage audio/visual equipment, verify networking and backup power lines across competition labs, and position sponsor signage and check-in kiosks.

tasks.title: Final Operations Readiness Review and Go-Live Signoff
tasks.description: Hold executive pre-flight check across finance, logistics, tech, and PR teams; issue emergency escalation protocols and initiate festival opening.
